_comment: EXT-63 SMOKE — 20 epochs (600 s at 30 s = epochs 0..600 inclusive = 21 solved epochs).
Identical posture to _ext63_gps_dual_1h.json, cut to the staged-cadence smoke length.
WHAT A PASS LOOKS LIKE (this is a WIRING + REACHABILITY smoke, not a science run):
1. The loader echoes 'Network producer (EXT-CB): ... EXTERNAL .BIA ... SH-VTEC ionosphere
CO-ESTIMATED' and 'Network producer: EXTERNAL-CLOCK HOLD ON ... sigma 0.0200 m'.
Their ABSENCE means a knob did not take (unknown JSON keys are silently ignored).
2. Solved epochs == walked epochs, 0 gate_withheld.  A 'declared S-basis dimension'
failure here is the interesting failure: it would say the clock anchors did not close
the gauge at this sigma, or that removing the CB columns opened a new near-null.
3. READ nshared IN THE LOG.  It must DROP relative to the golden control (the ~130
satellite code-bias columns are gone and the phase-bias set halves under dual).  An
unchanged nshared means external_sat_code_bias did not take effect.
4. Non-zero row counts after the two coverage gates.  require_atx_coverage +
require_bia_for_signals both DROP observations; if either is over-eager on this
fixture the station/observation counts collapse and everything downstream is
meaningless.  Check the per-station observation counts before reading anything else.
IF IT FAILS, BISECT IN THIS ORDER (5 variables move vs the golden control):
a. drop require_atx_coverage + require_bia_for_signals  (coverage, cheapest to rule out)
b. drop clock_datum_broadcast_anchored                  (rung B alone)
c. drop external_sat_code_bias, keep dual               (leaves dual + W6 = known ZERO
epochs, so this arm is the control that must FAIL — see _golden63_gps_1h_dual.json)
20 epochs is INSIDE IGNITION on this lineage: no total_IF, no carry retention, no AR, no
position claim.  It answers 'does the posture run and is the wiring live', nothing more.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY.  Own paths; never resume onto another arm's snapshot.
